rule: A task is failing until its check passes, run by the evaluator.

tasks.title: The constitution with its checks and states
tasks.check: every rule names a check or says unenforced and which task adds it
tasks.evidence: written 2026-10-31 (C1 to C18); waiting on the evaluator (S7), which alone passes a task

tasks.title: PROGRESS.md, and the session loop written into CLAUDE.md's working notes
tasks.check: a fresh agent given only CLAUDE.md finds the spec in hand and the next task in under five reads

tasks.title: Hooks: push gate, budget, honesty, loop breaker
tasks.check: each hook tried once on purpose and refuses: a push without a gate stamp; a commit past its owners; a number with no command; a fourth try

tasks.title: The provenance check, the placeholder scan and the secret scan in the gate
tasks.check: a planted unsourced figure, a planted placeholder and a planted key pattern each fail the gate; removed, it passes
tasks.evidence: 2026-11-01: tests/nexus/domains.test.ts with tests/nexus/scans.ts; a planted unsourced record and a TODO in src/data/woods.ts and an AWS-shaped key in a tracked doc each failed it, by file and line; removed, it passes

tasks.title: Evaluation sets: the AI's 30 requests with the runner and today's baseline; the products set once the user names them
tasks.check: npm run eval:agent prints steps, tokens, seconds, right or wrong for each, and the baseline is recorded in REALITY.md with its command

tasks.title: The routing test covers plan/ as it covers docs/
tasks.check: a plan file not routed from CLAUDE.md or plan/README.md fails the test
tasks.evidence: 2026-11-01: tests/nexus/domains.test.ts, "every source file has an owner in the docs": a planted plan/STRAY.md and a planted plan/specs/99-x/a.md each failed it; the real plan passes

tasks.title: The evaluator: its brief, three scored examples, the rule that only it flips a task
tasks.check: given a passing and a failing piece of past work, it judges both right

tasks.title: The first decision records (0001 to 0007) written
tasks.check: each has options, choice, assumption and re-test

tasks.title: The reviewer panel (research 11) with a quorum and stop signals (research 12): code judges with a veto; judges of different families; any gate may raise a concern the orchestrator must answer (Crew Resource Management)
tasks.check: a planted wrong answer is caught; a raised concern blocks until answered

tasks.title: Stop the line (C25) and a non-punitive near-miss log for the AI (error, at-risk, reckless, each with its response)
tasks.check: an open andon blocks 'done'; a caught near miss is logged with its kind

tasks.title: Dailies: the AI shows what changed since the last session, and the person approves, notes or kills each version; versions never overwritten
tasks.check: a session opens with its changes listed; a killed version is kept but not used

tasks.title: Prompts as versioned prompt nodes with frozen suites; untrusted text only through a schema-only extractor (CaMeL)
tasks.check: an injected instruction in a fetched page does not reach the planner

tasks.title: Post-mortems as a timeline, contributing factors and a hindsight guard (Allspaw, Dekker, SRE), replacing five whys; Perrow's chart computed from any board's structure (research 20)
tasks.check: a failed task's post-mortem has a timeline and factors, and names no culprit
